rules.statement: Heuwirtschaft is supported for mown grassland and arable fodder areas.

conditions.expression: parcel is mown grassland or eligible arable fodder
conditions.description: Only the named types form the measure area.

rules.statement: The multiannual commitment runs to 31 December 2028 and is at least four years: starts 2023/2024/2025 run 6/5/4 years.

conditions.description: Allowed starts and terms are fixed.

rules.statement: The no-mowing-conditioner option is a calendar-year commitment.
Participation requires simultaneous UBB, Biologische Wirtschaftsweise, or the BIO partial-farm variant.

conditions.expression: base_measure is ubb, bio, or bio_partial

rules.statement: In the first participation year at least 2.00 ha mown meadows and mown pastures excluding litter meadows and mountain meadows must be managed.

result.description: Minimum participation area met; lower area is allowed in subsequent years.

rules.statement: The holding must be a livestock holding in the first participation year.

conditions.description: RGVE per hectare of fodder area reaches threshold.

rules.statement: A livestock holding has at least 0.30 RGVE per hectare of fodder area, being grassland plus arable fodder.
RGVE are converted using the complete Annex A animal-category factors.

conditions.description: Each animal count is multiplied by its Annex A factor.

rules.statement: For livestock classification, arable fodder comprises Futtergräser, Wechselwiese, Kleegras, Klee, Luzerne, sonstiges Feldfutter and Ackerweide; second-crop arable fodder does not count.

conditions.expression: arable fodder crop and not second crop
conditions.description: Crop membership and annual status decide inclusion.

result.description: Included in fodder area; second crops excluded.

rules.statement: Silage preparation and silage feeding are prohibited throughout the holding, irrespective of animal species or remote farm buildings.

conditions.expression: no silage prepared and no silage fed

result.description: No prohibited silage preparation or feeding.

rules.statement: Fresh green maize for immediate feeding or rapid processing to dried pellets for own use, and grass feeding, are allowed only where fermentation is excluded; liquid molasses and beet-pulp pellets are permitted, but wet beet pulp and brewer's grains are not.

conditions.expression: operation is listed permitted material/use and fermentation excluded

result.description: Use does not breach silage ban.

rules.statement: From 1 January of the first contract year, no silage may be stored and own silage stocks may not be consumed.

result.description: No silage storage or consumption of own stocks.

rules.statement: Hay production must be combined with green feeding by grass feeding or grazing for the majority of 1 April–30 September for all roughage-consuming animals; communal pasture and alpine grazing count.

conditions.expression: green feeding occurs during majority and for all roughage animals

rules.statement: Mowing material may be transferred to others only as dry hay; actions suggesting silage use, including a single tedding followed by removal and green-feed transfer between hay-farming holdings, are prohibited.

conditions.description: Only dry hay transfer is allowed.

rules.statement: No silage may be produced from growth on the holding's grassland; haylage/Gärheu is prohibited.
If the no-mowing-conditioner option is claimed, mowing conditioners may not be used anywhere on the holding and no such device may be present; this applies to mowing for grass feeding and hay.

conditions.expression: option_no_mowing_conditioner implies no use and no device present

rules.statement: A mowing conditioner is equipment combined with the mower or used separately that crushes, kinks or chops cut material to aid drying.

conditions.expression: equipment performs crushing, kinking or chopping for drying

result.description: Device is covered by option prohibition.

rules.statement: The measure must be applied for in the MFA measures application by 31 December before the contract begins; last entry was funding year 2025 (application by 31 December 2024).

result.description: Contract may be formed for following year.

rules.statement: The no-mowing-conditioner option requires ticking the MFA Angaben attachment; last option entry is funding year 2028.

From 2024, qualifying mown grassland and arable fodder excluding Ackerweide receive EUR 145.80/ha for a livestock holding, EUR 167.40/ha with compliant no-conditioner option, and EUR 0/ha if not livestock holding.

conditions.description: Rate selection by livestock status and option.

rules.statement: After the first contract year livestock status affects only premium amount; falling below 0.30 RGVE/ha later creates no recovery for years previously classified livestock, but obligations remain.

result.description: No premium in affected year; obligations continue.

rules.statement: Grassland and arable fodder must annually be fully mown and mowing material removed, or fully grazed; mountain meadows require mowing and removal at least every two years.
Relevant funded land and animals must be in Austria.

conditions.expression: land and animals located in Austria

rules.statement: The same performance is not fundable under ÖPUL where it is funded from another public title or legally/officially prescribed, except stated Natura 2000/WRRL cases.

conditions.expression: no overlapping public or mandatory performance

rules.statement: For multiannual obligations, area reductions caused by cessation/change are allowed annually up to 5% but at most 5 ha, and in all cases 0.50 ha; exceeding it triggers repayment for all difference areas.

conditions.expression: reduction <= min(5% prior-year measure area,5ha) or reduction <=0.5ha

result.description: Repayment applies to all difference areas if threshold exceeded.

rules.statement: For Heuwirtschaft on grassland, area access is fully premium-eligible in 2024–2025; later it is limited to 50% of 2025 area, with up to 5 ha always allowed; previously equally committed land is not access.
Heuwirtschaft on arable land is tied to annually available areas and may vary each year.

conditions.expression: arable parcel claimed in current year

result.description: No multiannual fixed-area rule for arable component.

rules.statement: If a payment application for a later year of a multiannual measure is missed, commitment and obligations continue but no payment is made that year; missed application beyond one year, exit or exclusion ends commitment and requires repayment of prior premiums.
All premiums are modulated by total farm area: 100% through 200 ha, 90% over 200–300 ha, 85% over 300–1,000 ha, and 75% over 1,000 ha.

conditions.expression: total farm area exceeds tier threshold

rules.statement: Content breaches are assessed by severity, extent, duration and frequency and may lead from warning/1% (from 2027) through 2–100% reduction; two 100% reductions result in exclusion and recovery of prior contractual premiums.

The reviewed 2026 drought notices contain no Heuwirtschaft-specific relaxation; their crop, biodiversity, erosion, livestock-race, nature and insecticide exceptions must not be applied to this measure without a stated link.

result.description: Do not extend notice exceptions by analogy.
